just got back from Mysore today and the ride back wasn't pleasant. my stomach finally couldn't handle something and things have been rough since friday. we had to make a pit stop and the bathrooms were not good- but i had little choice. thank god for wipes- they didn't have tp, could you imagine??!!
we went for a walk the other night and we saw cockroaches running around. as we're walking Andy goes- do NOT move. of course i freeze in horror since i felt a bug on my neck. then he decides to flick the massive bug off. i was not thrilled. who fucking does that? everyone knows you flick the bug then tell the person. there was a mechanical horse we wanted to ride but the dude said we were too heavy. we told the kid there to ride it and he said he had to sweep the floor. awww
tonight is the first night i'm not consuming alcohol. the other night Sarah asked if she was too much (she's very lively) and Andy said she was the kool-aid man. lol! it's totally true too.
some houses out here have pretty drawings in front- they use rice powder. it's pretty cool. has some coconut juice today- not sure how i've never had it before. it was pretty good! glad it wasn't sweet- i can't handle anymore sweetness. ugh. the desserts here are too sweet. all i want is a costco hotdog!! is that too much to ask?
we're all used to the traffic now but i still haven't taken a rickshaw- that's a must. we were cracking up because they use horns here to lets others know they are there (organized chaos) all the time- it's so loud. we were saying that if we lived here we'd have a bumper sticker that says honk if you love jesus. haha
last night was our adventure in drunkeness in Mysore. we went to this nightclub in our hotel- it was pretty dead except for me jenna and andy, and this other group of peep who are taking yoga classes. they were chill. a french guy told andy that the french like americans now that Obama is our president. haha we smoked out of a hooka, danced, and drank a bottle of vodka. god it's making me sick thinking about it.
saturday we went to a couple temples, the palace (highlight of the day), then to a light show which was weak when you've seen the bellagio one. today we went to the top of the mtn before we left and we saw lots of monkeys! they were awesome.
i'm so tired and dehydrated that i'll have to finish tomorrow- i'm done for the night. peace!
